status: Adopted by reference in metadata/sources.json (#1311) and read by the development arms of the H5 candidate; off in the published declarations at every lead above 1, and read by no published record. 'Off in the published declarations' means this, and only this: metadata/sources.json (treasury_auctions, scheduled_availability) is the declaration every published record and the live record are scored under, and the final-test pre-registration freezes it by its bytes. Since #1311 its note and evidence date a settlement from the auction announcement and take this file's rule, its handling of a record with no or a misordered announcemt_date, and its evidence as their own; its machine-read availability is still the one instant that block can state, 15:00 on the panel day before the settlement (days = 1), so every published record and the live record read a settlement at h = 1 only, where this file gives the same column. This file's own instant (12:00 on announcemt_date) is read, at h = 2 to 5, by repo_model.settlement_dating and repo_model.s3c_announced: the development arms (s3c-ann), (s3c-ann-net), (s3c-ann-flagnet) and (s3c-ann-gross) and the #541 rescoring studies. No published declaration reads it at any lead above 1. Eleonora ruled on 10 October 2026 (relayed on #541) that a settlement is dated from the auction announcement and, on 29 October 2026 (#1310), that metadata/sources.json adopt it. Bound under owner attestation (scripts/owner_attested.py, #1327): a change to this file needs her own GO.

columns.treasury_settlement: every auction settling on the day
columns.treasury_settlement_bills: the auctions whose security_type is a declared bill type (contract.TREASURY_BILL_SECURITY_TYPES)
columns.treasury_settlement_coupons: the auctions whose security_type is a declared coupon type (contract.TREASURY_COUPON_SECURITY_TYPES)

rule: An auction's settlement date (issue_date) and offering amount (offering_amt) are public from its announcement: 12:00 New York time on its announcemt_date. For the forecast made h panel days before a settlement day d, at the declared decision time on that panel day, a settlement column for d is the sum, in USD billions, of the offering amounts of the auctions settling on d that had been announced by 12:00 on that day. An auction not yet announced is not in the sum. The announcement fixes the offering, so an auction that has not been held, or whose result is not on file, is in the sum from its announcement. At h = 1 this is the published panel's column on every panel day, because every auction settling inside the panel was announced before it was held (the tracked snapshot's announcemt_date never follows auction_date), and was held at least one panel day before it settled (sources.json, treasury_auctions, scheduled_availability evidence).
missing: A record with no announcemt_date, or one dated after its auction or after its settlement, is refused (ValueError): it would date the settlement from nothing or from after it happened. A settlement day with no auction on file reads 0.0 inside the snapshot's coverage, as the published panel does (data.build_daily_panel rule 8), and a hole outside it. treasury_settlement_soma, an auction result outside the aggregate, is not dated by this declaration and is a hole under it.
evidence: The tracked snapshot tests/fixtures/snapshots/funding_inputs/treasury_auctions/20260914T051023Z_722359ea9bc7.json (Fiscal Data auctions_query, retrieved 2026-09-14T05:10:23Z) dates every auction's announcement by announcemt_date, with no clock time, and in all 3828 records the announcement is on or before the auction date and the settlement date. For auctions settling inside the panel the announcement is, in calendar days before settlement, one to eleven for bills (7 for 2184 of 2360) and three to twenty-one for notes and bonds. The TreasuryDirect page 'How auctions work' (https://www.treasurydirect.gov/auctions/how-auctions-work/, read 11 October 2026) lists what each announcement carries (security, amount, auction date, issue date) and says only that the list of upcoming auctions is 'Updated every Friday by 10:45 AM, Eastern U.S. time'; it states no clock time for an individual announcement. Treasury's own announcement files state a release time (#1301, metadata/announcement_release_times_1301.json, read on 29 October 2026 from the 3828 announcement files of the snapshot, none unreadable): 3665 state an 'Embargoed Until' time (11:00 for 3535 of them, 08:30 for 117 notes and bonds, 09:30 for 9, 13:30 for 2 bills, 12:50 for 1 cash management bill, 16:15 for 1 note) and 163 say 'for immediate release' with no time (153 cash management bills, 7 bills, 3 notes and bonds). Against the declared 12:00 on announcemt_date: the one file that states a time after the 16:00 decision is a note announced 2019-08-15 that settles 11 weekdays later; three state a time between 12:00 and 16:00 (two bills announced 2018-12-04 at 13:30 and a cash management bill announced 2022-05-17 at 12:50, each settling 5 weekdays later), which the 12:00 instant counts before they were public, though all three were public by the 16:00 decision; the 163 'for immediate release' announcements state no time at all. The 12:00 instant is therefore a declared setting checked against Treasury's files, not a published clock time. At the 16:00 decision any declared instant from 11:00 to 15:59 gives the same sums, so the announcements that could move a sum are the 16:15 file and any 'for immediate release' announcement actually released after the decision, which the files cannot show. A cash management bill is not announced 'the same or the previous day': of the 458 cash management bills settling inside the panel (issue_date from 2018-04-03) in the tracked snapshot, 403 were announced five Monday-to-Friday days before settlement (330 when market holidays, metadata/market_holidays.json, are not counted as days; recounted in the tree for #1327). 2020 (development days, a diagnosis and not a verdict): the net arm's loss against (s3c) is not separable from the immediate-release cash management bills. Target days on which an auction with no stated release time settles carry 67.5% of (s3c-ann-net)'s 2020 grid-CRPS loss (29.4% of (s3c-ann)'s), and with those days left out the net arm's 2020 loss is no longer one (-0.9%, d +0.013 [-0.011, +0.037], undecided); the dating is ruled out as the cause of the flag arm's 2020 loss and not ruled out for the net arm (docs/research/s3c-ann-net-diagnosis-1319-result.md, #1320, Table 4d). repo_model.settlement_dating.auction_results refuses a record announced after its auction or its settlement.
